name: yoink
description: A clean, local GUI for yt-dlp.
author: The Guy

scripts.dev:electron: concurrently --kill-others -n next,electron -c blue,magenta "next dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && node electron/build.mjs && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron dist-electron/main.js"
scripts.build:electron: node electron/build.mjs && next build && node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && cross-env YOINK_INSTALLER_RESOURCES=1 node scripts/fetch-ytdlp.mjs && electron-builder --win
